# `tools/spawn/SpawnManager.js`

> **Source:** `engine/tools/spawn/SpawnManager.js`

SpawnManager.js - Unified entity and particle spawning Handles spawning physics objects with render resources, and particle emitters with fluid sim integration.

## Functions

### `spawnEntity(options)`

Spawn a physics object with full render resource setup.

**Parameters:**

- `options` *(Object)* — Spawn options
- `options.ecsWorld` *(Object)* — ECS world
- `options.position` *(Array)* — Spawn position [x, y, z]
- `options.type` *(string)* — Object type (cube, sphere, etc.)
- `options.spawnerProps` *(Object)* — Optional spawner properties
- `options.gpu` *(Object)* — GPU state with device
- `options.renderPipeline` *(Object)* — Render pipeline
- `options.lightsBuffer` *(Object)* — Lights buffer
- `options.uniformByteLength` *(number)* — Uniform buffer byte length
- `options.meshes` *(Object)* — Mesh lookup { cubeMesh, sphereMesh, etc. }
- `options.spawnedEntities` *(Array)* — Array to add spawned entity to
- `options.uniformBuffers` *(Map)* — Map to store uniform buffer
- `options.bindGroups` *(Map)* — Map to store bind group
- `options.logger` *(Function)* — Optional logger

**Returns:** Spawn result or null

### `spawnParticleEmitter(options)`

Spawn a particle emitter at position.

**Parameters:**

- `options` *(Object)* — Spawn options
- `options.position` *(Array)* — Spawn position
- `options.spawnerProps` *(Object)* — Spawner properties with color/scale
- `options.particles` *(Object)* — Particle state
- `options.smoke` *(Object)* — Smoke state (for fluid sim trigger)
- `options.onFirstEmitter` *(Function)* — Callback for first emitter (starts fluid sim)
- `options.maxEmitters` *(number)* — Max emitters before removing old ones (default: 16)
- `options.logger` *(Function)* — Optional logger

**Returns:** Created emitter or null
